# Outlier

> Mac-native local AI runtime with a custom paged Mixture-of-
> Experts inference engine. Runs frontier-scale models like
> Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on 64GB Apple Silicon Macs by streaming
> expert weights off SSD. Offline, no API tokens, no usage caps.
> Includes a Claude-Code-class agent loop (plan / act / verify /
> recover), MCP connectors, Projects, Code Agent v2, and 7 model
> tiers from 4B to 397B.

## Key documents
- [Homepage](https://outlier.host/)
- [How it works](https://outlier.host/learn/)
- [Comparisons](https://outlier.host/vs/)
- [Run on your Mac](https://outlier.host/run/)
- [Benchmarks and data](https://outlier.host/data/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Outlier-host)
- [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Outlier-Ai)

## Pricing (verified 2026-05-19)
- Free: Nano 4B + Lite 9B tiers, Apache 2.0 weights
- Standard: $149 one-time, Quick/Core/Code/Vision tiers
- Pro: $30/mo or $249/yr, all tiers including Plus 397B
- Founders: $200 lifetime, 500 seat cap, all tiers forever

## Verification
- Head-to-head outputs vs Claude Opus on 54 prompts at
  /data/outlier-vs-claude-54-prompt-benchmark/
- V11 streaming engine K-sweep at /data/v11-streaming-benchmarks/
- Local-AI-on-Mac comparison at /data/local-ai-mac-2026-benchmarks/
- All numbers carry provenance to source files
